messages:
jamie: Heads up — planning to stage-roll v3.2.1 this week. Need quick sync on toggle scopes + guardrails. Proposed: percent ramp 5->25->100 over 24h and EU-first region hold. Thoughts? @alex @sophia

alex: Prefer 10->30->100, 6h steps. 5% is too noisy for perf signals. Also need infra capacity check.

sophia: Agree on EU-first. Can we gate by customer tier? only prod-tier customers for first 25%.

mike: From infra: GPU pools have headroom for EU, but APAC is tight. If we route EU-only at first we'll be fine.

laura: Suggest adding automated rollback: p95 increase >20% or error-rate >0.5% (i.e. 0.005). Also push alerts to #incidents and paging.

jamie: Good — add those to rollout policy. Who can add the flag config? I can create the feature flag if someone approves.

alex: I'll review the PR. Use feature-flag service path: feature/model_v3_2_1.unleash. Example metadata: regions=[eu], percent=10, cohorts=[prod-tier].

sophia: Quick config draft below — feel free to copy into the PR:
```json
{
  "flag": "model_v3_2_1",
  "phases": [
    {"region": "eu", "pct": 10, "cohort": "prod-tier", "duration": "6h"},
    {"region": "eu,na", "pct": 30, "duration": "18h"},
    {"region": "global", "pct": 100, "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "rollback_metrics": {"p95_pct": 20, "error_rate": 0.005},
  "owners": ["jamie", "alex"],
  "notes": "staged unroll for v3.2.1, EU first, restrict prod-tier until 30%"
}
```

infra-bot: deploybot: rollout job queued for feature/model_v3_2_1 at 1785009900

jamie: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR with that config and link the infra ticket. @alex please gate the code-review.

alex: On it. Also add a small traffic_profile sample so perf team can simulate realistic token distribution.

sophia: Can someone set the observability dashboard for this flag? Need p95, p99, errors, tokens/sec, and avg tokens per request.

mike: I'll create a dashboard and wire alerts in Grafana + Alertmanager. ETA ~2h. Will include auto-rollback webhooks.

laura: Also add a post-rollout checklist: 24h quality eval, run eval prompt-set, quality/regression checks (semantic similarity), and update release notes.

ops: ops-bot: Noted — will set oncall rotation for first 12h and notify SRE.

jamie: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll schedule rollout Fri 09:00 UTC. Say 'no' now if conflicts.

alex: fine by me

sophia: works for me

mike: ok

laura: ok

jamie: Great — PR coming in 15m. Will include the config above, traffic_profile link, and dashboard ids. We'll run the first phase at 10% EU -> evaluate before expanding.

infra-bot: deploybot: PR 4523 opened by jamie -> awaiting review (link: https://git.internal/reviews/4523)

jamie: tagging this thread with the rollout ticket: INF-3219. Ping here for any blockers. :eyes:
